**Nexo v0.3** adds images in chat, custom keybinds that work in games, and much better noise
suppression. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** images need the updated server. On the host, back up `server/data`, run `git pull`, then
> restart the Nexo server.

## What's new

- **Images in chat.** Paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V), drag files onto the channel, or click **📎**. You can
  send up to 4 images per message, with or without text. PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF are supported, and GIFs
  stay animated. The limit is 10 MB per image; bigger screenshots are compressed automatically. Click an
  image to view it full size.
- **Keybinds.** **Settings → Keybinds** has global shortcuts that work while a game has focus:
  **Push to talk**, **Toggle mute**, **Toggle deafen**, **Toggle screen share** and **Leave voice**. They
  take keys, mouse buttons and combinations like **Ctrl+Shift+M** or **Alt+Mouse 5**. None are set by
  default. **Toggle screen share** restarts your last stream (same screen or window, same quality)
  without leaving the game. **Quick switcher** (Ctrl+K) and **Open settings** (Ctrl+,) can be rebound
  too.
- **Noise suppression.** **Settings → Audio & video → Noise suppression** offers **Off / Standard /
  Enhanced**. **Enhanced** is the new default. It uses RNNoise, a small neural network that runs on your
  PC, to remove keyboard clicks, fans and background hiss while keeping your voice. In testing, your
  voice's margin over the noise went from 24 dB (Standard, the old default) to 30 dB. **Hear yourself**
  lets you compare the modes, so use headphones.

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below. The installers are **not
code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time.

- **Windows:** run `Nexo-Setup-<version>.exe`. If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click
  **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag Nexo to **Applications**. The first time, **right-click Nexo →
  Open → Open**. If macOS says the app "is damaged", run `xattr -cr /Applications/Nexo.app` in Terminal.
  Allow Nexo in **Privacy & Security → Accessibility** for global keybinds.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Nexo-*.AppImage && ./Nexo-*.AppImage`. On Wayland, keybinds work only while Nexo
  is focused.
